## Services and expertise

- Product design for mobile apps, SaaS products, dashboards, and web apps
- Web3 UX for wallets, signing flows, transaction review, onboarding, and trust states
- Fintech UX for verification, investor flows, credit requests, profiles, and admin workflows
- Website UX for service businesses, software companies, protocol websites, and B2B consulting
- Figma design systems, reusable components, responsive states, and developer handoff
- UX audits for hierarchy, clarity, accessibility, conversion, content, and implementation risk

## Selected work

- Yarsha: Web3 messaging app UX with chat, wallet interaction, blinks, AI bots, and transaction review
- Mokshya.io: Web3 protocol website focused on clearer hierarchy and trust-building product storytelling
- Hamro Idea: Brand and static multi-page website for a Nepal-based software studio

- Zapp Today: Logistics mobile product design for customer, driver, and admin workflows
